==Notes==
*Because the healing triggers on attacks and not on hits, skills that cause multiple attacks will trigger Vigorous Spirit multiple times, whereas skills that cause only multiple hits trigger Vigorous Spirit once.
**The attacker is healed very quickly when attacking with [[daggers]] due to their fast attack speed and chance to [[double strike]].
**Activates with skills like [[Illusionary Weaponry]], since Vigorous Spirit only requires an attack, not a hit.
* [[Dervish]]es are a good target for this skill, since they tend to frequently use flash enchantment while simultaneously attacking with melee attacks, both of which triggers the healing.
{{anomaly|[[Empathy]] triggers on [[fail]]ed [[attack skill]]s, whereas Vigorous Spirit does not.}}
